save_checkpoint: save a model checkpoint with optimizer state, epoch, and config to a .pyth file
load_checkpoint: load a checkpoint file into a model with optional 2D to 3D weight inflation
load_train_checkpoint: load a training checkpoint with auto-resume or from a specified file path
load_test_checkpoint: load a test checkpoint from config path or the latest checkpoint in the output directory
inflate_weight: inflate 2D convolution weights to 3D convolution weights for video action recognition models
